records.question: Under the Data Protection Act 2018, what is the minimum age at which a child can consent to information society services in the UK?
records.answer: Under the Data Protection Act 2018, the minimum age at which a child can independently give consent to the processing of their personal data in relation to information society services in the UK is 13 years old. Under Section 9 of the Data Protection Act 2018, the age at which a child can give consent to information society services under Article 8 of the UK GDPR is set at 13 years old. Section 9 of the Data Protection Act 2018 modifies the default EU GDPR Article 8 threshold of 16 years down to 13 years for information society services within the UK legal framework. ⚖️
records.why: 3 pages we opened, from 3 independent sites, state this.
caveats: The AI reviewer wasn't available, so this rests only on the pages I could open and check.
